name: Cuban Sandwich

ingredients.item: Cuban or hoagie roll, halved lengthwise

instructions: Spread mustard on the inside of both halves of the roll.
Layer ham, pulled pork, Swiss cheese, and pickles on the bottom half.
Close the sandwich and press firmly.
Butter the outside of both sides of the bread.
Cook in a panini press or weighted skillet over medium heat, pressing down firmly.
Cook 3-4 minutes per side until bread is golden and cheese is melted.

substitutions.dairy_free: Skip cheese or use dairy-free Swiss.
